original_full_audit.purpose:
Validate one complete model from disjoint breaking-case partitions.

Each case is audited against branch evidence from its own partition. Duplicate
branch identifiers across partitions are retained separately, never overwritten.
Recorded pointwise comparisons are checked; integration is not rerun here.

original_full_status.purpose:
Audit a predetermined complete partition inventory across workflow runs.

Collectors download artifacts; this tool performs no network requests or
integrations. Every selected file must match its original checksummed ZIP.
The existing model auditor keeps each partition's branch evidence separate.

configuration.candidate_selection: union of both engines' literal MATLAB resistance/sensitization eligibility
configuration.continuation: continue if any eligible engine has not passed the raw MATLAB reversal test
configuration.third_trial: new breaker identity excluding UCS, first breaker and response; both nonzero levels
configuration.zero_breaker_policy: exclude as in MATLAB; record candidate count before simulation
configuration.retry_policy: one declared fallback after solver exception only; no retry after a completed numerical mismatch
configuration.summary_statistic: arithmetic sample means and ranges; not continuous-time integrals
configuration.controls: prior history x breaker sequence x final rechallenge, all eight combinations
